# Signora AI
> AI receptionist software for US dental practices.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://signoraai.com/): 24/7 AI receptionist for dental clinics.
- [Blog](https://signoraai.com/blog.html): Guides on dental AI receptionists and call answering.
- [Best AI Receptionist in the US](https://signoraai.com/best-ai-receptionist-us.html): Buying criteria for dental practices comparing AI receptionists.
- [AI Solutions for Dental Clinics](https://signoraai.com/ai-solutions-dental-clinics.html): Practical AI use cases for dental front desks.
- [What Is an AI Receptionist?](https://signoraai.com/ai-receptionist.html): Definition, workflows, and limits.

## Key Facts
- Signora AI serves US dental practices.
- Signora AI answers patient calls, books appointments, manages reschedules, and transfers complex issues to staff.
- Signora AI is designed for front-desk workflows and does not provide clinical advice.
- Contact: ai.signora.in@gmail.com
